**Breakdown:**

- Total global sales: 927.26 million units

**Assumptions and Methodology:**

- **Data scope**: Included all Role-Playing genre games across all platforms (the database shows many JRPG titles with 100% Japanese sales, indicating strong localization).

SELECT 
  s.name,
  s.platform,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sl.region = 'JP' THEN sl.sales ELSE 0 END) as jp_sales,
  SUM(sl.sales) as total_sales,

FROM sales_long sl
JOIN games g ON sl.name = g.name AND sl.platform = g.platform
WHERE g.genre = 'Role-Playing'
GROUP BY s.name, s.platform
ORDER BY jp_percentage DESC
LIMIT 20
